WITH state_special_schools AS (
    -- Identify state special schools - looking for schools with specific ownership codes or types
    SELECT DISTINCT s.CDSCode, s.School 
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.SOCType IN ('Special Education', 'State Special School')
       OR s.SOC = '67'
       OR s.DocType LIKE '%Special%'
),
school_data AS (
    -- Get enrollment and grade level data for state special schools
    SELECT 
        fs.CDSCode,
        fs.SchoolName,
        fs.LowGrade,
        fs.HighGrade,
        fs.Enrollment_K12,
        COALESCE(ss.NumTstTakr, 0) AS NumTstTakr
    FROM frpm fs
    JOIN state_special_schools sss ON fs.CDSCode = sss.CDSCode
    WHERE fs.Academic Year = '2014-2015'
),
grade_level_ranking AS (
    -- Determine the starting grade level for each school
    SELECT 
        CDSCode,
        SchoolName,
        LowGrade,
        Enrollment_K12,
        NumTstTakr,
        CASE 
            WHEN LowGrade = 'P' THEN 0
            WHEN LowGrade = 'K' THEN 1
            WHEN LowGrade = '1' THEN 2
            WHEN LowGrade = '2' THEN 3
            WHEN LowGrade = '3' THEN 4
            WHEN LowGrade = '4' THEN 5
            WHEN LowGrade = '5' THEN 6
            WHEN LowGrade = '6' THEN 7
            WHEN LowGrade = '7' THEN 8
            WHEN LowGrade = '8' THEN 9
            WHEN LowGrade = '9' THEN 10
            WHEN LowGrade = '10' THEN 11
            WHEN LowGrade = '11' THEN 12
            WHEN LowGrade = '12' THEN 13
        END AS GradeLevelNum
    FROM school_data
),
ranked_schools AS (
    -- Rank schools by grade level (highest first), then enrollment (largest first), then name alphabetically
    SELECT 
        SchoolName,
        LowGrade,
        Enrollment_K12,
        NumTstTakr,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY GradeLevelNum DESC, 
                     Enrollment_K12 DESC, 
                     SchoolName ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM grade_level_ranking
)
SELECT

    Enrollment_K12,
